C0531.title: Man Sentenced for Selling 'Non-Stop Phone Harassment' Services via Online Store
C0531.summary: In September 2023, victim Wang received 24 harassing phone calls and over 200 SMS verification code spam messages within five minutes, originating from a 'non-stop phone harassment' service sold by Li through his online store. Li illegally profited 10,000 yuan from providing such malicious harassment services and taught the method to others, ultimately leading to a criminal sentence.

references.title: 24 harassing calls in 5 minutes! Man opens online store selling 'non-stop calling' service, sentenced - Li
